title: Construction of the second adic system with its double-quotient comparison
statement: Let $X$ be Noetherian and $I,K$ quasi-coherent ideals, and let $M\in\operatorname{Coh}(X,I)$, with coherent modules, positive-power quotients and completion as in [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], [pqf-def-coherent], [pqf-def-locnoeth]. Suppose completion is an equivalence on every $V(K^e)$ for $e\geq1$. Let $H$ be coherent and $\alpha:M\to\widehat H_I$, with a single positive $t$ killing the kernels and cokernels of every component by $K^t$. Then there exist $N\in\operatorname{Coh}(X,K)$ and $\delta:N\to\widehat H_K$ with componentwise kernels and cokernels killed by one positive power of $K$. There is an isomorphism of doubly indexed diagrams $\sigma_{e,n}:N_e/I^nN_e\simeq M_n/K^eM_n$, natural in both positive indices. There is also the canonical quotient interchange $\theta_{e,n}:(H/K^eH)/I^n\simeq(H/I^nH)/K^e$, characterized by equality after the two quotient projections from $H$. For every $e,n$, the square commutes: $\sigma_{e,n}$ followed by the reduction of $\alpha_n$ equals the reduction of $\delta_e$ followed by $\theta_{e,n}$.

proof.text: Use the coherent and formal closed-immersion equivalences to identify the completion functor on V(K^e) with the completion functor on objects killed by K^e. Algebraize each quotient system M_n/K^e M_n. Full faithfulness uniquely lifts its quotient transitions and their quotient isomorphisms; these define N in Coh(X,K). Their compatible comparisons give sigma in both indices.

The two iterated quotients both corepresent maps from H vanishing on I^n H and K^e H. Their cokernel universal properties give theta and the projection identity. Lift the quotients of alpha by the same equivalences; faithfulness gives delta and the comparison square.
Remark 0888 applied to reduction modulo K^e gives the bound K^(2t). Its equivalence of annihilation conditions transfers it from the completed map to each lifted delta_e, with uniform bound K^(4t).
